etymology: the article interposed or (#Jos 18:28) simply the former part of the word or _*Myre tyrq*_ Qiryath `Ariym keer-yath' aw-reem' from 07151 and the pl. of 03293 or 05892
definition:
Kirjath-jearim = "city of forests"

 1) a city on the northern boundary of Judah and on the western and
    southern boundaries of Benjamin
    1a) also 'Kirjath-baal' and 'Baalah'
